answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 23 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the vault solution is checked at the reef gate and logged, the sonnet audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Slashing removes 76 percent at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
